name: obsidian-mcp-router-bridge
description: Adds /search/smart, /templates/execute, GET /open/<path>, and GET /ping REST routes to the Local REST API plugin, plus a presence heartbeat for smart-link device detection. Companion plugin for the multi-vault MCP router. No native binary, no telemetry.

scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: tboome33
